Read: Instagram and Facebook brought in 130 of the 197 leads and 71 of the 97 patients who showed up. Google again had a 100% show rate: all 23 of its leads booked and attended. WhatsApp leads book reasonably well (58.8%) but none of the 20 booked appointments resulted in a show, so these leads need faster and tighter follow-up. Overall booking and show rates are in line with August (80.6% / 61.3%).
Definitions: Booked = held an appointment (Show or No-show; excludes Cancelled). Booking Rate = Booked ÷ Leads. Show Rate = Show ÷ Booked. Figures are taken from the client leads sheet as logged (entries up to 23 September). Booking and show rates depend on the team logging every lead, not only booked ones.

Overall Performance Analysis

Meta Overall
Meta generated 1,764 messaging conversations from AED 28,880.32 in spend, at a blended cost of AED 16.37 per message. Compared with August (1,851 messages at AED 16.14), volume was slightly lower (−4.7%) on slightly lower spend, while blended cost per message stayed broadly stable.
Instagram vs Facebook
Instagram delivered 1,094 messages at AED 17.28, an improvement in cost per message versus August (AED 18.15) on lower spend. Facebook was the only Meta platform to grow message volume, reaching 670 messages (+3.7%), but its cost per message rose to AED 14.89, continuing a steady upward trend since June (AED 8.41).
Service Mix
LASIK and Presbyond accounted for 1,632 of 1,764 Meta messages, at blended costs of AED 15.70 and AED 16.10. Cataract grew to 132 messages (from 98 in August) at AED 22.37, with a clear platform gap: AED 15.85 on Facebook versus AED 28.90 on Instagram.
Google Ads
Google generated 135.99 conversions, up from 124 in August, with impressions (+26.7%) and clicks (+17.0%) also rising. Spend increased faster than results, lifting cost per conversion to AED 69.09. WhatsApp clicks remained the main conversion type at 72.8%, and most lost impression share came from ad rank rather than budget.
TikTok
TikTok delivered 515,410 video views and reached 317,919 people from AED 1,421.34 in spend, slightly above August and the highest levels of the last four months. Paid follows came in at 644 (vs 740 in August), with the Follow campaign driving 575 of them. The top creative “A city this beautiful” generated 50,892 focused views at around AED 0.01 each.
